title: The Seleucid Kingdom
lead: The Greek kingdom founded by Seleucus I, one of Alexander the Great's generals, which ruled Syria, Mesopotamia and, from 200 BC, Judea. Its king Antiochus IV provoked the Maccabean revolt; its civil wars in the following decades let the Hasmoneans win independence. Daniel 11 traces its wars with the Ptolemies of Egypt as "the king of the north".
